sentences.text: 去年夏天，小林把家搬到了上海。
sentences.en: Last summer, Xiao Lin moved to Shanghai.

sentences.text: 刚到的时候，他觉得这个城市太大了，常常找不到路。
sentences.en: When he had just arrived, he felt the city was too big and he often got lost.

sentences.text: 他也不认识什么人，所以周末一般一个人在家看电视。
sentences.en: He didn't know anyone either, so at weekends he usually watched TV at home alone.

sentences.text: 有一天，他下地铁的时候，把手机忘在座位上了。
sentences.en: One day, when he got off the subway, he left his phone on the seat.

sentences.text: 他一发现就急得不知道怎么办。
sentences.en: As soon as he noticed, he was so worried he didn't know what to do.

sentences.text: 这时候，一个年轻的女孩跑过来，把手机还给了他。
sentences.en: Just then, a young girl ran over and gave the phone back to him.

sentences.text: 原来她就住在小林家旁边的楼里。
sentences.en: It turned out she lived in the building right next to Xiao Lin's.

sentences.text: 为了感谢她，小林请她喝了一杯咖啡。
sentences.en: To thank her, Xiao Lin bought her a cup of coffee.

sentences.text: 后来，她带他去了很多好玩的地方。
sentences.en: Later, she took him to many fun places.

sentences.text: 现在小林越来越喜欢上海了。
sentences.en: Now Xiao Lin likes Shanghai more and more.

questions.q: Why did Xiao Lin often get lost at first?
options: He always took the wrong bus

questions.q: Where did he leave his phone?
How does Xiao Lin feel about Shanghai now?
options: He likes it more and more

sentences.text: 王丽的好朋友叫张月。
sentences.en: Wang Li's good friend is called Zhang Yue.

sentences.text: 上个星期，张月在电话里说：“我的生日快到了。”
sentences.en: Last week, Zhang Yue said on the phone: "My birthday is coming soon."

sentences.text: 王丽以为她的生日就是这个星期六。
sentences.en: Wang Li thought her birthday was this Saturday.

sentences.text: 她花了很多时间，给张月做了一个大蛋糕。
sentences.en: She spent a lot of time making a big cake for Zhang Yue.

sentences.text: 星期六早上，她拿着蛋糕去了张月家。
sentences.en: On Saturday morning, she carried the cake to Zhang Yue's home.

sentences.text: 张月打开门，看见蛋糕以后，觉得很奇怪。
sentences.en: Zhang Yue opened the door, saw the cake and thought it was very strange.

sentences.text: “我的生日是下个月十号啊！”她笑着说。
sentences.en: "My birthday is on the 10th of next month!" she said with a smile.

sentences.text: 王丽这才明白，原来是自己听错了。
sentences.en: Only then did Wang Li understand that she had misheard.

sentences.text: 虽然今天不是生日，但是两个人还是高兴地把蛋糕吃完了。
sentences.en: Although it wasn't her birthday, the two of them still happily ate up the cake.

sentences.text: 张月说：“下个月你还得再做一个！”
sentences.en: Zhang Yue said: "Next month you'll have to make another one!"

questions.q: When did Wang Li think Zhang Yue's birthday was?
When is Zhang Yue's birthday really?
What did they do with the cake?

sentences.text: 下个星期一，大卫要参加汉语考试。
sentences.en: Next Monday, David will take a Chinese exam.

sentences.text: 他已经学了两年汉语，但是还是很紧张。
sentences.en: He has already studied Chinese for two years, but he is still very nervous.

sentences.text: 每天晚上，他都在图书馆复习到十一点。
sentences.en: Every evening he reviewed at the library until eleven o'clock.

sentences.text: 考试前一天，他把所有的书都看了一遍。
sentences.en: The day before the exam, he read through all his books once.

sentences.text: 那天晚上他太累了，一上床就睡着了。
sentences.en: That night he was so tired that he fell asleep as soon as he got into bed.

sentences.text: 第二天早上，他的手机没响，他起晚了！
sentences.en: The next morning his phone didn't ring, and he got up late!

sentences.text: 他马上打了一辆出租车，让司机开得快一点儿。
sentences.en: He immediately took a taxi and asked the driver to drive a bit faster.

sentences.text: 到了学校，他跑进教室，发现里面一个人也没有。
sentences.en: When he reached the school, he ran into the classroom and found nobody inside.

sentences.text: 老师走过来告诉他：“考试是下午两点，不是上午！”
sentences.en: The teacher walked over and told him: "The exam is at two in the afternoon, not in the morning!"

sentences.text: 大卫笑了，他用这几个小时又复习了一遍。
sentences.en: David laughed and used those few hours to review everything once more.

sentences.text: 最后，他的考试成绩非常好。
sentences.en: In the end, his exam result was excellent.

questions.q: Why did David get up late?
options: He went to bed very late

questions.q: Why was the classroom empty?
options: He went to the wrong school
The exam was in the afternoon

questions.q: How did David do in the exam?

sentences.text: 李阿姨住在一个老小区的三楼。
sentences.en: Auntie Li lives on the third floor in an old residential compound.

sentences.text: 最近，她每天晚上都被楼上的声音吵醒。
sentences.en: Recently, she has been woken up every night by noise from upstairs.

sentences.text: 声音不大，但是一直到半夜才停。
sentences.en: The noise wasn't loud, but it didn't stop until midnight.

sentences.text: 她越来越生气，决定上楼去看看。
sentences.en: She got angrier and angrier and decided to go upstairs to have a look.

sentences.text: 开门的是一个十几岁的男孩，手里拿着一本书。
sentences.en: The one who opened the door was a teenage boy holding a book.

sentences.text: 男孩说他的父母在外地工作，他一个人在家准备考试。
sentences.en: The boy said his parents worked in another city and he was at home alone preparing for an exam.

sentences.text: 他晚上睡不着，就在房间里走来走去地背课文。
sentences.en: He couldn't sleep at night, so he walked back and forth in his room reciting texts.

sentences.text: 李阿姨听了以后，一点儿也不生气了。
sentences.en: After hearing this, Auntie Li wasn't angry at all any more.

sentences.text: 她告诉男孩，睡觉前喝一杯热牛奶，就容易睡着了。
sentences.en: She told the boy that if he drank a cup of hot milk before bed, it would be easier to fall asleep.

sentences.text: 第二天，她还给男孩送去了一碗热面条。
sentences.en: The next day, she also brought the boy a bowl of hot noodles.

sentences.text: 从那以后，楼上安静多了，两个人也成了好朋友。
sentences.en: From then on, it was much quieter upstairs, and the two of them became good friends.

questions.q: What kept waking Auntie Li up?
Why was the boy walking around at night?
options: He couldn't sleep and was reciting texts
He was looking for his parents

questions.q: What advice did Auntie Li give the boy?

sentences.text: 快放假了，小张一家正在讨论去哪儿旅游。
sentences.en: The holidays are coming, and Xiao Zhang's family is discussing where to travel.

sentences.text: 爸爸想去海边，因为他喜欢游泳。
sentences.en: Dad wants to go to the seaside because he likes swimming.

sentences.text: 妈妈想去北京，她说那里的历史文化很有意思。
sentences.en: Mom wants to go to Beijing; she says the history and culture there are very interesting.

sentences.text: 小张只想在家玩电脑游戏。
sentences.en: Xiao Zhang only wants to play computer games at home.

sentences.text: 大家说了一个小时，也没有决定下来。
sentences.en: Everyone talked for an hour but still couldn't decide.

sentences.text: 最后，奶奶出了一个主意：“你们都来我家吧！”
sentences.en: Finally, Grandma had an idea: "All of you come to my place!"

sentences.text: 奶奶住在南方的一个小城市，离海很近，城里还有一个很老的博物馆。
sentences.en: Grandma lives in a small city in the south, close to the sea, and the town also has a very old museum.

sentences.text: 这样，爸爸可以游泳，妈妈可以参观博物馆。
sentences.en: This way, Dad can swim and Mom can visit the museum.

sentences.text: “那我呢？”小张问。
sentences.en: "What about me?" asked Xiao Zhang.

sentences.text: 奶奶笑着说：“我家也有电脑，不过你得先陪我去公园散步。”
sentences.en: Grandma smiled and said: "My home has a computer too, but first you have to go for a walk in the park with me."

sentences.text: 大家都同意了，这个假期的计划就这样定下来了。
sentences.en: Everyone agreed, and that's how the holiday plan was decided.

questions.q: Why did Dad want to go to the seaside?
Who solved the problem?
What must Xiao Zhang do before using the computer?
options: Walk in the park with Grandma

sentences.text: 周六下午，刘明骑自行车去超市买东西。
sentences.en: On Saturday afternoon, Liu Ming rode his bike to the supermarket to buy things.

sentences.text: 那天刚下过雨，路上很滑。
sentences.en: It had just rained that day, and the road was very slippery.

sentences.text: 他一边骑车一边听音乐，没注意前面有一只小狗。
sentences.en: He was listening to music while riding and didn't notice a little dog ahead.

sentences.text: 为了不撞到小狗，他突然停了下来，结果自己摔倒了。
sentences.en: To avoid hitting the dog, he stopped suddenly, and as a result he fell off.

sentences.text: 他的腿受伤了，手机也被摔坏了。
sentences.en: His leg was hurt, and his phone was broken in the fall too.

sentences.text: 小狗的主人是一位老奶奶，她马上跑过来把刘明扶了起来。
sentences.en: The dog's owner was an old lady; she ran over at once and helped Liu Ming up.

sentences.text: 她非常不好意思，一定要带他去医院看看。
sentences.en: She felt very sorry and insisted on taking him to the hospital to get checked.

sentences.text: 医生检查以后说，问题不大，休息几天就好了。
sentences.en: After the examination, the doctor said it wasn't serious and he would be fine after a few days' rest.

sentences.text: 老奶奶还要给他买一个新手机，刘明却怎么也不同意。
sentences.en: The old lady also wanted to buy him a new phone, but Liu Ming wouldn't agree no matter what.

sentences.text: 他说：“是我自己不小心，以后骑车再也不听音乐了。”
sentences.en: He said: "It was my own carelessness. From now on I'll never listen to music while riding again."

questions.q: Why didn't Liu Ming notice the dog?
options: He was talking on the phone

questions.q: What happened to his phone?
Why did he refuse the new phone?
options: He felt the accident was his own fault
The old lady had no money

sentences.text: 安娜来中国已经半年了，她特别喜欢吃中国菜。
sentences.en: Anna has been in China for half a year, and she especially loves Chinese food.

sentences.text: 可是饭馆的菜越来越贵，她决定自己学做饭。
sentences.en: But restaurant food was getting more and more expensive, so she decided to learn to cook herself.

sentences.text: 她请同事小王教她做西红柿炒鸡蛋。
sentences.en: She asked her colleague Xiao Wang to teach her to make tomato and egg stir-fry.

sentences.text: 小王说这个菜很简单，先把鸡蛋炒好，再放西红柿。
sentences.en: Xiao Wang said the dish is simple: first fry the eggs, then add the tomatoes.

sentences.text: 第一次做的时候，安娜把糖当成了盐。
sentences.en: The first time she made it, Anna mistook the sugar for salt.

sentences.text: 她放了很多糖，菜变得非常甜。
sentences.en: She put in a lot of sugar, and the dish became very sweet.

sentences.text: 她觉得很难过，想把菜倒掉。
sentences.en: She felt very upset and wanted to throw the dish away.

sentences.text: 小王尝了一口，却说：“太好吃了！”
sentences.en: Xiao Wang tasted a bite, but said: "It's delicious!"

sentences.text: 原来小王是上海人，他家做这个菜的时候也放糖。
sentences.en: It turned out Xiao Wang is from Shanghai, and his family also puts sugar in this dish.

sentences.text: 从那以后，安娜一有时间就在家做饭。
sentences.en: From then on, whenever Anna had time, she cooked at home.

sentences.text: 现在她已经会做十几个菜了。
sentences.en: Now she can already make more than ten dishes.

questions.q: Why did Anna decide to learn to cook?
What mistake did Anna make?
options: She used sugar instead of salt

questions.q: Why did Xiao Wang like the dish?
options: He didn't want to make her sad
His Shanghai family also cooks it with sugar

sentences.text: 陈静大学毕业以后，一直在找工作。
sentences.en: After graduating from university, Chen Jing had been looking for a job.

sentences.text: 有一天，她收到一封电子邮件，一家公司请她去面试。
sentences.en: One day she received an email: a company invited her to an interview.

sentences.text: 面试那天，她穿上了最漂亮的衣服，提前半个小时出了门。
sentences.en: On the day of the interview, she put on her nicest clothes and left home half an hour early.

sentences.text: 在公司楼下，她看见一位老先生拿着很多东西，走得很慢。
sentences.en: Downstairs at the company, she saw an old gentleman carrying lots of things and walking very slowly.

sentences.text: 虽然时间有点儿紧，但是她还是帮他把东西搬到了十楼。
sentences.en: Although time was a bit tight, she still helped him carry his things up to the tenth floor.

sentences.text: 等她跑到面试的办公室时，已经晚了五分钟。
sentences.en: By the time she ran to the interview office, she was already five minutes late.

sentences.text: 她心里很着急，觉得这次一定没有希望了。
sentences.en: She was very worried and felt there was surely no hope this time.

sentences.text: 可是她一进门就吃了一惊，坐在里面的正是那位老先生！
sentences.en: But as soon as she walked in she was startled: the person sitting inside was that very old gentleman!

sentences.text: 原来他就是这家公司的经理。
sentences.en: It turned out he was the manager of the company.

sentences.text: 经理笑着说：“不用紧张，你刚才的表现就是最好的面试。”
sentences.en: The manager smiled and said: "Don't be nervous. What you did just now was the best interview."

sentences.text: 一个星期以后，陈静开始在这家公司上班了。
sentences.en: A week later, Chen Jing started working at the company.

questions.q: Why was Chen Jing late for the interview?
options: She helped an old man carry his things

questions.q: Who was the old gentleman?
What happened in the end?
options: She had to come back another day
